description_en: Generates an assessment report for a specified compliance package in a specified account group
description_zh: 为指定账号组内的指定合规包生成评估报告
kebab_example: aliyun config generate-aggregate-compliance-pack-report --compliance-pack-id cp-fdc8626622af00f90000 --client-token 1594295238-f9361358-5843-4294-8d30-b5183fac0000 --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --multi-files true --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateAggregateCompliancePackReport

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For information about how to obtain the compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The `ClientToken` can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For information about how to obtain the account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to generate multiple files based on resource ownership user IDs. Valid values:

true: generates multiple files (default)

false: generates a single file
parameters.help_zh:
是否按资源归属用户ID生成多个文件，取值：
true：生成多个文件（默认值）
false：生成单个文件
parameters.name: multi_files

CompliancePackId.description_en: The ID of the compliance package
